scope: Public observations of product families at regional assembly hubs. These are not current throughput measurements or supplier-specific purchase orders. Publication dates restrict which supply links can enter historical model topology.

zhengzhou.basis: Apple identifies the Zhengzhou iPhone 14 Pro/Pro Max assembly facility in its dated public update; no earlier availability is assumed from this source.

source.title: Apple: iPhone assembly in Zhengzhou, November 6, 2022

shenzhen.basis: China Labor Watch's first-hand 2012 investigation, Foxconn factory profile, identifies iPhone production in Longhua, Songgang and Guanlan. Only this evidenced product family is used.

source.title: China Labor Watch: Shenzhen Foxconn factory investigation, June 27, 2012, factory profile pp. 89-93

chennai.basis: India's NHRC names Foxconn's iPhone assembly plant in Sriperumbudur in its July 1, 2024 press release. This source is not backdated to earlier events.

source.title: NHRC India: Foxconn iPhone assembly plant at Sriperumbudur, July 1, 2024

bengaluru.basis: India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry confirms contracted iPhone manufacturing in Bengaluru in its dated parliamentary answer.

source.title: Government of India: manufacturing iPhones in Bengaluru, parliamentary answer July 23, 2018

northern-vietnam.basis: Bac Giang's government portal describes Fukang's iPad/MacBook production in the province. This reviewed portal snapshot has no independently verified original publication date; it is conservatively unavailable to all earlier historical model folds.

source.title: Bac Giang government external-information portal: Fukang iPad and MacBook production, reviewed October 14, 2026
